tracks.title: Web Dev Adventurer
tracks.description: Master core syntax, control flow, functions, and data manipulation.

nodes.title: The Variable Crystal
nodes.briefing: Lumo needs an energy source! Declare a variable named crystalPower and set its value to 100.
nodes.initialCode: // Declare crystalPower below

nodes.title: Conditional Gateways
nodes.briefing: Create a function canPassGate(keyCard) that returns true if keyCard === 'GOLD', otherwise false.

nodes.title: The Loop Labyrinth
nodes.briefing: Write a function sumTo(n) that returns the sum of all integers from 1 to n inclusive.

nodes.title: Array Armoury
nodes.briefing: Write a function doubleAll(arr) that returns a new array with every element multiplied by 2.

nodes.title: Object Vault
nodes.briefing: Write a function getFullName(person) that takes an object with first and last properties and returns the full name as a string.

tracks.title: Game Dev Pioneer
tracks.description: Learn 2D physics loops, velocity adjustments, and collision math.

nodes.title: Gravity Physics
nodes.briefing: Pip is falling! Write a function applyGravity(entity, gravity) that adds gravity to entity.vy.

nodes.title: Velocity Clamp
nodes.briefing: Write a function clampSpeed(entity, maxSpeed) that clamps entity.vy so it never exceeds maxSpeed.

testCases.description: Does not change if under maxSpeed

nodes.title: AABB Collision
nodes.briefing: Write isColliding(a, b) that returns true if two axis-aligned rectangles overlap. Each has x, y, w, h.

tracks.title: Visual & UI Pioneer
tracks.description: DOM manipulation, CSS math, and Canvas 2D drawing methods.

nodes.title: DOM Text Selector
nodes.briefing: Ember wants to update the page! Write a function updateHeading(id, text) that finds an element by id and sets its textContent to text.

testCases.assertion: const el = { textContent: '' }; const orig = document.getElementById; document.getElementById = (i) => i === 'h1' ? el : null; updateHeading('h1', 'Hello'); document.getElementById = orig; el.textContent === 'Hello'

nodes.title: Element Crafter
nodes.briefing: Write a function createBadge(label) that creates a new div element, assigns it the class badge, sets its text to label, and returns it.

nodes.title: Canvas Rectangle
nodes.briefing: Write a function drawSquare(ctx, x, y, size) that calls ctx.fillRect(x, y, size, size).

testCases.assertion: let called = null; const ctx = { fillRect: (...a) => called = a }; drawSquare(ctx, 10, 20, 50); JSON.stringify(called) === JSON.stringify([10, 20, 50, 50])

nodes.title: Color Interpolator
nodes.briefing: Write a function getRGB(r, g, b) that returns a CSS color string in the format rgb(r, g, b).

tracks.title: Optimization & Refactoring
tracks.description: Array transformations, filtering, scope, and clean functional code.

nodes.title: Array Transformer
nodes.briefing: Echo prefers elegant code! Write a function doubleValues(numbers) using .map() that returns a new array with each value doubled.

nodes.title: Bug Filter
nodes.briefing: Write a function filterErrors(logArray) using .filter() that returns only the strings that do not start with '[ERROR]'.

testCases.assertion: JSON.stringify(filterErrors(['[ERROR] crash', 'info OK', '[ERROR] timeout', 'done'])) === JSON.stringify(['info OK', 'done'])

testCases.description: Returns empty array when all errors

nodes.title: XP Accumulator
nodes.briefing: Write a function sumXP(xpList) using .reduce() to compute the total XP from an array of numbers.

nodes.title: Safe Exec
nodes.briefing: Write a function safeParse(jsonString) that tries to parse the string as JSON and returns the parsed object, or null if parsing fails.

tracks.title: Cosmic Capstones
tracks.description: Multi-assertion mini-projects combining logic, data, and physics.

nodes.title: Scoreboard State Engine
nodes.briefing: Create an object ScoreTracker with a score property (starting at 0), an addPoints(pts) method that adds to the score, and a reset() method that sets it back to 0.

nodes.title: Bounding Box Collision
nodes.briefing: Write a function checkCollision(rectA, rectB) that returns true if two rectangles (each with x, y, w, h) are overlapping, false otherwise.

nodes.title: Inventory Item System
nodes.briefing: Create a function Inventory() (or class) that manages an internal items array. It must expose addItem(item) and hasItem(item) methods.

testCases.assertion: const inv2 = Inventory(); inv2.addItem('shield'); inv2.hasItem('shield') === true

testCases.description: hasItem returns false for missing item
testCases.assertion: const inv3 = Inventory(); inv3.addItem('bow'); inv3.hasItem('axe') === false

nodes.title: Game Loop Delta Tracker
nodes.briefing: Write a function updatePosition(entity, dt) that updates an entity's position: entity.x += entity.vx * dt and entity.y += entity.vy * dt.

testCases.assertion: const e = {x:0, y:0, vx:5, vy:0}; updatePosition(e, 2); e.x === 10
const e2 = {x:0, y:0, vx:0, vy:3}; updatePosition(e2, 4); e2.y === 12
const e3 = {x:10, y:5, vx:2, vy:-1}; updatePosition(e3, 1); e3.x === 12 && e3.y === 4
